scenarios.label: Deterministic Crossword creation
scenarios.description: Create a generated Crossword with a fixed seed and confirm same-seed reproducibility.

scenarios.label: Different-seed Crossword creation
scenarios.description: Create a generated Crossword with a different seed and confirm output sensitivity.

scenarios.label: Intentional 2 ms seed collision
scenarios.description: Diagnostic-only: two distinct seeds 2 ms apart yield the same generated layout, so the seed-sensitivity check must classify BUG instead of PASS. This is a documented diagnostic collision and never a product requirement of universal seed injectivity.

scenarios.label: Ambiguous Crossword host (diagnostic)
scenarios.description: Diagnostic-only: the host role matches more than one active product Layout, so pre-action host resolution must classify HARNESS_BLOCKED before any native input and never guess a host.

obligations.description: Different-seed sensitivity is a release-mandatory risk.
